evidence:
WHAT PASSES (most of the row). The product is interactive and time-varying; it is not themed or responsive by public choice (instruction.md:5 'We don't need a dashboard, theme switching or a special phone layout'), so the template's 390x844 resize and per-theme review (template visual prompt 'set a roughly 390 by 844 viewport', 'If the application offers more than one theme') are correctly dropped: visual/prompt.md:14 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone-layout or theme-switching requirement' and visual judge.toml hro_vis_color 'No theme-switching requirement'. No criterion grades resize or toggle, so none is left unexercised. No dimension scores a still first paint: every scored prompt requires sign-in, a UI creation and a fresh-context readback before scoring (functional/prompt.md:13, polish/prompt.md:11, visual/prompt.md:11) and visual then reviews six workspaces plus detail/form surfaces (visual/prompt.md:14). Time-varying behaviour has explicit wait instructions: functional/prompt.md:77 'press Tab and allow up to3 seconds' for worked figures, and for live updates 'After the other user's action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page. Wait for the expected text with a15-second timeout, or take snapshots; accept an update that is present in the first snapshot taken at or after15 seconds ... An update that needs a reload or click is a failure of the L row, not a reason to reload and pass it.' The three live rows carry a before-state control and a no-interaction rule (judge.toml:1334 hro_live_stale_mark, :1343 hro_live_source_flag, :1352 hro_live_committed_viewer), and hro_live_stale_mark also waits 15 s for the non-invalidating direction, so an app that marks everything stale or never updates fails. Interaction is exercised by typing/clicking: hro_desk_figures (:1307, one-cent change and restore), hro_desk_remove_member (:1316), hro_desk_field_refusal (:1325), hro_entries_reload (:1370, workspace switch then reload), and polish hro_pol_live_keeps_entries / hro_pol_session_resume / hro_pol_focus (polish/judge.toml:23,32,41) with polish/prompt.md:16 'do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement and window.scrollY with page.evaluate; reading them is not interaction' and 'read document.activeElement immediately after each outcome, before any further click'. Broken-app probe: an app that only refreshes on reload/click, or that re-renders the editor on arrival (clearing value/focus/scroll), is caught by these rows; 'If no update arrives within15 seconds ... give0 ... never reload to obtain it'. The public basis exists (instruction.md:9; hireops_rules.md:521-535 'within 15 seconds, with no reload and nothing clicked').

DEFECT (viewport/scroll exercise presumes document scrolling). polish/judge.toml:23 hro_pol_live_keeps_entries: 'Scroll so the page is not at the top and that field is still visible. Record the field's value, that it is document.activeElement, and window.scrollY ... the page has not jumped to the top and the field is still in the viewport ... Fails if the arriving update ... resets the scroll position.' polish/prompt.md:16 names window.scrollY as the only scroll reading. The public requirement is 'how far I have scrolled' (instruction.md:9) / 'the page's scroll position' (hireops_rules.md:533-534) with 'Layout, wording and mechanism are yours' (:489). No fallback is given when the document itself does not scroll, and no resize is prescribed to make it scroll. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:15 lists 'scroll containers' among defaults of the golden that must not become requirements. The golden scrolls the window (app.js:292-294 saves/restores window.scrollX/Y; styles.css has no app-shell scroll pane), and the scripted evidence used window.scrollTo(0,260) at 1440x900 (live-desk.cjs:63,90-91,102), so the golden's own choice is the only one the instrument fits.

MEASUREMENT GAP. Raw-evidence hashes verified for live-desk.cjs (45a57f0e…), results/live-desk.json (3d1f9523…), server.log (6752f461…) and the frozen app.js/change-sets.js/styles.css match the index. live-desk.json records 'out-of-date mark and superseded-source flag arrive without reload; typed value, focus and scroll kept' passed, arrival_ms 807, and 'viewer sees COMMITTED without reload' passed. That is scripted Playwright against the golden with API fixture setup, not the configured claude-code/glm judge through playwright-mcp: whether that judge actually holds a second context open across tool calls, waits 15 s without touching the page, and reads focus before its next click is unmeasured. I did not verify that @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19) exposes a tool named browser_run_code_unsafe. No Oracle, model or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail: a desktop app shell whose header/nav are fixed and whose Coordinated Changes pane scrolls inside its own container (main{height:100vh;overflow:auto}), or a compact desk that fits the judge's viewport without scrolling. Live updates preserve the typed 41.5, focus and the pane's scrollTop exactly as the brief asks. window.scrollY is 0 before and after and the judge cannot 'scroll so the page is not at the top' by the only instrument the prompt names, so a literal judge returns 0 or NOT EXERCISED (also 0) for hro_pol_live_keeps_entries (weight 3 of 12 in Polish, about 5% of reward) although the product meets the public requirement. Inverse: for such a container app the window.scrollY comparison is vacuous; only the 'field is still in the viewport' leg detects a scroll reset.
suggested_fix: In hro_pol_live_keeps_entries and polish/prompt.md, measure scroll on whatever actually scrolls: record window.scrollY and the scrollTop of the field's nearest scrolling ancestor plus the field's getBoundingClientRect().top before and after, pass when the field's on-screen position is unchanged; if nothing can scroll because the desk fits the viewport, grade value and focus only instead of failing.
